archigos-4.1.title: Archigos: A Data Set on Leaders 1875–2015, version 4.1
archigos-4.1.citation: Goemans, Gleditsch and Chiozza (2009), Journal of Peace Research 46(2), 269–283.
archigos-4.1.scope: Effective primary leaders of independent states in the authors' state system, observed 1875–2015; inherited spells can begin earlier. Not all monarchs or all heads of state.
archigos-4.1.reuse: Public author-hosted research download; authors request citation. No explicit open-data licence found on the download page.
limitations: Censored ends are observation cutoffs, not asserted exits.
Country codes can span regime changes; match historical atlas identity and time explicitly.
PLT/H-DATA incorporates Archigos and is not wholly independent.
